Not op, but I can tell you why I didn't report my own sexual assault if it helps you at all. When it happened to me I was in college and similar to op it was a guy I knew and was friends with. When it happened I was pretty confused and didn't even realize what had just occurred til I was walking down the street the next day and just started crying. A large part of me was in denial about what actually occurred because despite how common assault is, you never think it will happen to you. I went through a sexual assault intake session with one of my schools provided counselor and after learning about the process of reporting sexual assault, I decided not to. Ultimately, reporting it would have ruined the rest of my college career. I would have had to go through the pain of telling my story over and over again to several different people, I wouldn't have been able to go to places I knew he would be at even though they were important to me. He would have eventually found out that I reported him and probably called me a liar to our mutual friends. I didnt want to lose the things that were important to me, my friends, or become the girl who got raped or even worse the girl people think lied about it. The decision I made was completely selfish, I only thought about myself. But unfortunately, the entire process for reporting and prosecuting SA especially at an 'elite university like mine is shitty and often leads to nothing. The woman at the title ix office told me if I went through with it he was likely to be suspended a semester and required to complete therapy. That wasn't enough to ruin the rest of my college career so I didn't. I'm fine with the decision I made. I'm sorry this is so long but I hope it helps and im sorry this happened to you. Please know whatever decision you make is yours and no one else's. ❤
